title: Billy Prescotts ad and Keyess ad
html_source:
Molly is tired of hearing Bloom talk about his problems selling ads.

Chapter 5
“Prescott’s dyeworks van over there. If I get Billy Prescott’s ad: two fifteen. Five guineas about.”

Chapter 7
“Like that, see. Two crossed keys here. A circle. Then here the name. Alexander Keyes, tea, wine and spirit merchant. So on.”
